name: check_and_update_open_hr_case
use_case: Handle leave request boundaries such as insufficient balance, overlaps, or exceptions via HR case
branch: An employee checks the progress of their open balance dispute HR case and provides supplementary confirmation notes to be appended to the case history.
tests: The agent retrieves the current status and latest note of the employee's HR case, and appends the employee's update note to the open case record.
instruction:
You have an open HR support case (CASE-4018) regarding 5 days of missing carry-forward leave from 2025. You want to check its current status and add an update note.

First, ask the assistant for the current status of CASE-4018.

Once the assistant reports that it is in review with People Ops, ask the assistant to add a note to the case stating: "Sent travel receipts and 2025 year-end payslip to payroll email for verification."

Your details:
- Name: Pooja Sharma
- Employee ID: E418
- Region: APAC
- Case ID: CASE-4018
- Note to add: Sent travel receipts and 2025 year-end payslip to payroll email for verification.

persona.name: Pooja Sharma
persona.initial_message: Hello HR, could you please check the status of my open HR case CASE-4018 and let me add a quick update note to it?

arguments.note: Sent travel receipts and 2025 year-end payslip to payroll email for verification.
